narration_script: Little Sicily is drowning in chaos after the murder of Bobby Gnucci.
Police morale is gutted and street crime spirals completely out of control.
Young punks terrorize the neighborhood and harass an old man and his dog.
Frank Castle lives haunted by memories of his time as a Recon Marine.
His mind fractures under the crushing weight of grief and survivor guilt.
He repeats the sacred oath that he shall never quit or surrender.
Drug addicts and street toughs roam the halls looking for easy targets.
The news reports link the vigilante Punisher directly to the ongoing violence.
A deranged intruder breaks into a local bakery shouting about threats inside walls.
Frank sits alone in the dark talking to the ghosts of his family.
He breaks down completely admitting he is tired and does not know what to do.
Visions of his past life flash violently across his mind with terrifying speed.
He screams in agony as the trauma threatens to swallow him whole.
Ground teams take heavy fire while desperate radio calls demand a medic.
hook: Little Sicily falls into brutal chaos after Bobby Gnucci dies.

narration_script: An elderly woman arrives at Frank Castle's door knowing his exact name.
She explains that her entire family was taken away in cold blood.
Loneliness is described as an ever-present hunger you cannot shake.
Benny came home smelling of cheap perfume and lipstick.
Bobby the oldest policeman was brutally butchered on the streets.
Eddie lit up every room he walked into before meeting his end.
Her youngest son Carlo was the thinker whose mind was his weapon.
At six forty-seven a devastating tragedy seared into her heart forever.
A bounty is placed on Frank Castle's head by the desperate Gnucci family.
Every madman and killer in the neighborhood is told to hunt him down.
Frank relives the agonizing choices that separated him from his loved ones.
Voices accuse him of choosing war over his own family.
Karen appears and tells him there is still more work for him to do.
Armed thugs flood the corridors screaming and searching for Frank.
hook: A grieving mother tracks down Frank Castle to extract bloody vengeance.

narration_script: Innocent bystanders are caught in the crossfire as gunmen swarm the building.
A mother and her young son Isaiah scream in absolute terror.
Gunmen shatter shop windows and demand to know where Frank is hiding.
Bullets tear through walls as the merciless manhunt intensifies.
Frank moves through the shadows dodging enemy fire with deadly precision.
Chaos erupts inside the local bakery as customers run for their lives.
Frank steps forward to protect the innocent child from the onslaught.
A brutal shootout leaves bodies scattered across the bloodied floor.
The young girl hands Frank a heartfelt token of gratitude.
Frank walks the empty streets contemplating his next move.
He recites the chilling rhyme about the batch and penny and dime.
A military veteran confronts him about a stolen cover from the past.
Frank stands his ground as armed thugs close in for the final kill.
The ultimate confrontation arrives as the trap springs shut.
hook: An army of hired killers traps Frank Castle in a deadly siege.
